title: Wood Firing Workshop - December 4-6
summary: Three-day anagama wood firing workshop with hands-on experience stoking, monitoring and steering the kiln in a small group setting. The December workshop is full; use the sign-up button to join the waitlist for the next firing.
bring: Pots from home and/or make pots in the studio during a separate throwing workshop
cost_text: $800 for wood firing alone, or $1,100 combined with a two-day throwing workshop (promotional rate)
source_quote: FIRST EVER FIRING WORKSHOP DEC 4-6... -DEC 4-6 Wood Firing workshop PROMOTIONAL RATE - $800... DECEMBER WORKSHOP FULL— Use the Workshop Sign-Up button below to be on the waiting list
evidence_sentence: The firing workshop page describes a three-day anagama wood firing workshop scheduled for December 4-6 where participants fire pots they formed beforehand.
evidence_quote: Learn to fire an anagama style wood kiln nestled on a wooded four-acre property during this small group workshop.
